sources.title: FP8 KV Cache — TensorRT Edge-LLM - nvidia.github.io
sources.snippet: FP8 KV Cache # Overview # FP8 KV cache reduces memory usage by quantizing the key-value cache from FP16 to FP8 (NVIDIA FP8 E4M3 format), achieving ~50% memory reduction and 9-17% faster context attention on Thor for d=128 models (3-7% for d=64).

sources.title: KV Cache Quantization: What FP8 and q8_0 Cost in Accuracy
sources.snippet: On a 128k needle test, FP8 KV cache fell from 91% to 13% with no error raised. What q8_0 and FP8 actually cost, by model family and build date.
